fusions.name: Skipped Spray
fusions.desc: Kicks up a spray of water that strikes the first enemy in line for 4 damage, then skips to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Placid Wake
fusions.desc: Kicks a wave of water out in every direction, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, pushing them 2 tiles back and leaving them [Damped] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Oiled Coat
fusions.desc: Blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you for 4 seconds. Transcendent damage still lands. You move 20% faster for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Lucky Iron
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a blow you failed to dodge rolls your dodge a second time, and the second roll stands.
